name: Using Qiskit quantum_info, prepare the state RY(2.544) on qubit 0 followed by CX
task_prompt: Using Qiskit quantum_info, prepare the state RY(2.544) on qubit 0 followed by CX(0,1), compute the reduced density matrix of qubit 0 via partial trace, and print its von Neumann entanglement entropy (base 2). The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
